value.rationale: This is the smallest Cartesian square grid with a four-point GP simplex; its homotopy is mixed-dimensional with 14 circles and a primitive 2-sphere. The nontrivial D4 action and rational quotient distinguish invariant classes invisible from the known complete face polynomial. The claim is finite, exactly natural and bounded, with no claim about larger grids.
